mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may increase skin irritation, photosensitivity, and potential for dermal adverse effects when combined with adapalene (retinoid), both of which can cause cutaneous reactions and increase sun sensitivity.
action: Monitor for enhanced skin irritation, erythema, and photosensitivity; ensure robust photoprotection (SPF ≥30) and consider timing of applications to minimize cumulative dermal toxicity.
